# pve_sdn_dns (Resource)

SDN DNS server backend configuration (powerdns).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_sdn_dns" "example" {
dns = "CHANGE_ME"
key = "CHANGE_ME"
type = "powerdns"
url = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dns` (String) The SDN dns object identifier.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) <string>
- `type` (String) Plugin type. One of: `powerdns`.
- `url` (String) <string>

### Optional

- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `fingerprint` (String) Certificate SHA 256 fingerprint.
- `lock_token` (String) the token for unlocking the global SDN configuration
- `reversemaskv6` (Number) <integer>
- `reversev6mask` (Number) <integer>
- `ttl` (Number) <integer>

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: dns (also the `terraform import` format).
